title: Protection of wiring or cables.
officialText:
Wires or cables that are located outside of the elevator hoistway and machine room
and that provide normal or standby power, control signals, communication with the car, lighting, heating, air conditioning,
ventilation and fire-detecting systems to fire service access elevators shall be protected by construction having a fire-resistance
rating of not less than 2 hours, shall be a circuit integrity cable having a fire-resistance rating of not less than 2 hours, or shall
be protected by a listed electrical circuit protective system having a fire-resistance rating of not less than 2 hours.
Exception: Wiring and cables to control signals are not required to be protected provided that wiring and cables do not
serve Phase II emergency in-car operation.
